items.use: 화산 용암 강을 경로를 따라 휘어 붙이는 띠 그림. 강 폭 124 = 띠의 둑 바깥 끝 폭. 코드가 강 방향으로 천천히 밀어 흐름을 보임. drawLavaSurface 교체용

refs.role: EXACT LOOK of the lava river in the approved gameplay concept: bright yellow-orange molten core with long flame streaks running along the river, red-orange edges, small dark crust islands, glowing cracks and dark basalt boulders on the banks
the same river lower in the concept: how the molten core, crust and basalt bank meet
whole volcano panel: palette, outline weight, flat painterly colour planes, scale of the river next to the balls

items.prompt: Paint one straight horizontal section of the volcano lava river from the approved gameplay concept (reference 1 is the target look), seen from the same elevated top-down view, as a seamlessly tileable strip. The river runs left to right across the full canvas width; its left and right edges must tile seamlessly with each other. The band is horizontal and centred vertically and takes about the middle 45% of the canvas height. From the centre outward: a bright yellow-orange molten core with long flame streaks flowing along the river direction (left to right), red-orange molten edges with a few small dark cooled-crust islands, then a narrow dark basalt bank with low dark rocks and thin glowing cracks along both sides. Outside the banks fade quickly to full transparency; the top and bottom of the canvas are fully transparent. Flat painterly colour planes and dark subtle outlines like reference 3. The flame streaks must clearly run along the river so that slowly scrolling the strip reads as flowing lava.
avoid: red dashed warning line, warning signs or any UI
balls, food pellets, text, arrows, range rings
a curved or diagonal river (keep it straight and horizontal)
volcano ground, large boulders or trees outside the banks
opaque background or checkerboard
glow or bloom spilling into the transparent area
road-like centre dashes or a repeating diamond pattern
photoreal lava or heavy gradients
accept: 원화의 용암 강(참조 1·2)과 같은 불꽃 줄기·주황 가장자리·검은 둑으로 보임
가로로 곧고, 왼쪽 끝과 오른쪽 끝이 이어 붙음
불꽃 줄기가 강 방향(가로)으로 흘러 밀면 흐름으로 보임

Paint one straight horizontal section of the volcano lava river from the approved gameplay concept (reference 1 is the target look), seen from the same elevated top-down view, as a seamlessly tileable strip. The river runs left to right across the full canvas width; its left and right edges must tile seamlessly with each other. The band is horizontal and centred vertically and takes about the middle 45% of the canvas height. From the centre outward: a bright yellow-orange molten core with long flame streaks flowing along the river direction (left to right), red-orange molten edges with a few small dark cooled-crust islands, then a narrow dark basalt bank with low dark rocks and thin glowing cracks along both sides. items.prompt: Paint the rounded end of the volcano lava river from the approved gameplay concept, seen from the same elevated top-down view. The river enters straight from the left edge of the canvas, horizontal and vertically centred, with its band taking about the middle 45% of the canvas height (same width as a straight river strip), and it ends near the centre-right in a rounded pool-like end. Same layers as the river: bright yellow-orange molten core with flame streaks, red-orange molten edges with small dark crust, and a narrow dark basalt bank with low dark rocks and thin glowing cracks that wraps around the rounded end. At the left edge the band must be cut straight so it joins a straight strip seamlessly. Everything outside the bank fades quickly to full transparency. Flat painterly colour planes and dark subtle outlines like the references.
avoid: red dashed warning line, warning signs or any UI
balls, food pellets, text, arrows, range rings
an eruption, smoke column or volcano cone
opaque background or checkerboard
glow or bloom spilling into the transparent area
photoreal lava or heavy gradients
accept: 왼쪽에서 띠와 같은 폭으로 들어와 둥글게 끝남
